subfield: Condensed matter physics: topological quantum matter and quantum transport
motivation: The quantum anomalous Hall effect realises quantised Hall conductance h/e² without any external magnetic field or Landau levels. This is the lattice Chern-insulator physics Haldane envisioned, now made real. Fang and Dai, with the late S.-C. Zhang, predicted in 2010 that magnetically doped tetradymite topological insulator films would give a robust Chern insulator, and they identified Cr-doped (Bi,Sb)2Te3 as the material. In 2013 Xue's group achieved precise MBE control of these disordered magnetic films and observed quantised, dissipationless chiral edge transport at zero field. Laboratories worldwide have since reproduced this. It is a striking case of topology producing exact quantisation in messy materials. The work founded a field: intrinsic MnBi2Te4, axion and Chern insulators, moiré QAH states and proposed resistance standards. The theory-experiment partnership behind it is exemplary.
